collections.title: Core Whiskies
collections.description:
Introducing the Wolfburn Distillery Single Malt Scotch Whisky Collection, a distinguished assortment celebrating one of Scotland’s youngest yet most promising distilleries. Located in the heart of Thurso, in the Scottish Highlands, Wolfburn has rapidly gained recognition for its commitment to traditional craftsmanship and innovative spirit. This collection offers an exceptional journey through the character and finesse of Wolfburn’s single malts, showcasing their unique contributions to the world of Scotch whisky.

The collection begins with the Wolfburn Northland, a flagship expression that captures the essence of the distillery’s early offerings. This whisky is known for its smooth, approachable profile, combining notes of honeyed malt, ripe fruits, and a hint of vanilla. It serves as an ideal introduction to the Wolfburn range, presenting a harmonious balance of flavours that reflect the distillery’s meticulous attention to detail and quality.

Next in the collection is the Wolfburn Morven, a more robust expression demonstrating peating's influence on Wolfburn’s malts. This whisky presents a captivating blend of smoky, earthy notes with an underlying sweetness, providing a dynamic contrast that highlights the versatility of Wolfburn’s approach to single malt production. Its complexity and depth make it a standout for those who appreciate a peated profile with refined character.

The Wolfburn Aurora is another gem in this collection, showcasing the distillery’s innovative maturation techniques. Finished in a combination of sherry and bourbon casks, the Aurora offers a rich, layered experience with notes of dried fruits, toffee, and a subtle spice. This expression exemplifies Wolfburn’s dedication to experimenting with cask finishes to create an engaging and memorable multi-dimensional whisky.

Finally, the collection features the limited edition Wolfburn Langskip, a rare and exceptional release that represents the pinnacle of the distillery’s offerings. With a deep, complex flavour profile characterized by rich oak, dark chocolate, and a hint of smoke, Langskip is a testament to Wolfburn’s skill in crafting single malts that balance intensity and elegance.

The Wolfburn Distillery Single Malt Scotch Whisky Collection is a celebration of craftsmanship and innovation. Each bottle reflects the distillery’s commitment to producing exceptional single malts that honor tradition while pushing the boundaries of flavour. Whether you’re a seasoned enthusiast or a newcomer to Wolfburn’s offerings, this collection provides a rich and rewarding exploration of one of Scotland’s most exciting new distilleries.

collections.title: Limited Edition
collections.description: Wolfburn’s range of limited edition single malt Scotch whiskies represents the very soul of small-batch craftsmanship—rare, distinctive, and crafted with unwavering attention to detail. Each release is a celebration of individuality, offering whisky lovers a chance to experience something truly unique. From our prized single cask bottlings, drawn from hand-selected barrels that showcase exceptional character, to special releases that highlight experimental cask finishes and unusual flavour profiles, these expressions are a testament to the creative spirit and traditional skill that define Wolfburn. No two are quite alike; some boast rich sherry cask depth, others deliver bold peat smoke or delicate coastal notes, but all share a signature smoothness and balance that comes from meticulous ageing and non-chill filtration. These whiskies are available only in small quantities, making them highly sought after by collectors and connoisseurs around the world. Whether released to mark a special occasion, commemorate a milestone, or simply explore the limits of flavour, each limited edition bottle carries with it a sense of rarity, provenance, and the quiet pride of a distillery that values quality above all.

collections.title: Miniature 5cl Single Malt Scotch Whiskies
collections.description:
Discover the Wolfburn Distillery Miniatures Collection, a curated assortment of 5cl bottles that offers a compact yet comprehensive journey through the essence of one of Scotland’s burgeoning whisky producers. Perfect for collectors, enthusiasts, or those eager to sample the distinctive expressions from this Highland distillery, each miniature in this collection provides a unique taste of Wolfburn’s craftsmanship and innovation.

This collection features four of Wolfburn's most celebrated single malts, each presented in a 5cl bottle that encapsulates the distillery’s commitment to quality and flavour.

The Wolfburn Northland miniature is an ideal starting point. Known for its smooth, approachable character, Northland delivers notes of honeyed malt, ripe fruits, and vanilla, capturing the essence of Wolfburn’s early offerings. It’s a perfect introduction to the distillery’s style, offering a balanced and inviting profile.

Next, the Wolfburn Morven miniature provides a robust contrast with its peated influence. This expression blends smoky, earthy notes with a subtle sweetness, demonstrating the versatility of Wolfburn’s production techniques. The Morven is a great choice for those who appreciate a richer, more complex single malt with a hint of peat.

The Wolfburn Aurora miniature showcases the distillery’s innovative approach to maturation. Finished in a combination of sherry and bourbon casks, this whisky presents a rich, layered experience with flavors of dried fruits, toffee, and a gentle spice. The Aurora miniature allows you to explore Wolfburn’s skill in creating multi-dimensional profiles through cask experimentation.

Finally, the Wolfburn Langskip miniature represents the pinnacle of the distillery’s offerings. With its deep, complex flavors of oak, dark chocolate, and a subtle wisp of smoke, Langskip is a rare and exceptional release that epitomizes Wolfburn’s dedication to crafting extraordinary single malts. This miniature is a must-have for those seeking a sophisticated and memorable whisky experience.

Each 5cl bottle in the Wolfburn Miniatures Collection is meticulously crafted to provide an authentic taste of the distillery’s distinctive character. Whether you're exploring Wolfburn for the first time or adding to an existing collection, these miniatures offer an excellent way to experience the rich and varied profiles of Wolfburn’s single malts in a convenient and collectable format. Ideal for tasting sessions, travel, or gifting, this collection delivers the essence of Wolfburn’s Highland heritage in a beautifully compact form.

collections.title: Tours
collections.description:
Experience the essence of craftsmanship with the Wolfburn Distillery Visitor Tours, an exclusive opportunity to explore the inner workings of one of Scotland’s most renowned whisky producers. Unlike many distilleries, Wolfburn does not operate a traditional visitor center. Instead, we offer an intimate and immersive tour that provides a rare glimpse into the heart of our distillery, guided by our knowledgeable Distillery Ambassadors.

**The Journey Begins:** Your adventure starts in the historic Still House, where you will witness the core of our spirit-making process. Here, our expert guides will walk you through the intricate details of our copper pot stills, explaining the art and science of distillation. You’ll gain insight into how our unique stills, combined with time-honored techniques, contribute to the exceptional quality and character of our single malts.

**A Glimpse into Maturation:** From the Still House, the tour continues to our maturation warehouses. This part of the journey offers a fascinating look at the aging process, where you’ll learn about the various cask types used to develop the complex flavors of our whiskies. Our guides will discuss the impact of different cask finishes and the importance of the aging environment in shaping the final product. Witnessing the casks up close provides a tangible sense of how time and wood contribute to the depth and richness of our spirits.

**Sampling the Excellence:** The tour culminates in an exclusive tasting session, where you will sample five of our award-winning whiskies. This guided tasting offers an opportunity to explore the bold, complex flavors that define Wolfburn’s range. Each whisky has been carefully selected to showcase the diversity and excellence of our single malts. Your Distillery Ambassador will provide detailed tasting notes and background on each expression, enhancing your appreciation of the subtle nuances and rich profiles of our whiskies.

**Personalized Experience:** Unlike larger distilleries, our approach ensures a personalized and engaging experience. With smaller tour groups, you will have ample opportunity to interact with our knowledgeable staff, ask questions, and delve deeper into the art of whisky making. 

The Wolfburn Distillery Visitor Tour is more than just a walk through a production facility; it is a comprehensive exploration of our dedication to the craft of whisky making. Join us for an unforgettable journey through our distillery, where tradition meets innovation, and discover the unparalleled quality of Wolfburn’s single malts.
